calculation.description: Ranks tradable assets by the negative of their trailing two-session return; weaker recent performers receive higher scores for a one-session reversal forecast. Missing observations are retained as missing rather than imputed.

validation.regime_notes: Positive in early (IC 0.043494, ICIR 0.125046) and middle (0.058885, 0.161510) regimes; weaker late regime (0.021535, 0.064414), so monitor drift.
